title: 计时
summary: 这一段时间是正数累计，还是倒数专注？先定会话的方向。累计没有上限；专注到 0 自己停住，不要变成负数，也不要弹一条 toast。
summaryEn: Does this session count up, or count down? Name the direction first. A stopwatch has no cap; focus stops itself at 0 — never negative, never a toast.
asks: 这一段时间是正数累计，还是倒数专注？
asksEn: Does this session count up, or count down?

links.when: 计时的方向不是进度能不能算
links.whenEn: session direction is not whether progress can be measured

links.when: 专注到点不是一条 toast
links.whenEn: focus hitting zero is not a toast
